contract.identity: Exact original path and size/mtime/inode bracket; one returned native job id belongs only to its invocation. A filename, partial digest, successful start or cancellation acknowledgement is not completion.

Raw data demux plus copy feeds every original byte to the SHA-256 muxer; no new public SDK or host API. ID3 inputs use the existing fingerprintTemplateFile full-byte implementation, preserving metadata and header bytes removed by older FFmpeg demuxers.
contract.effects: Read-only original-file access through an owned native media process. Starting/cancelling that process uses the assembly existing allowCommit context; no source rewrite, user-data deletion or saved Draft mutation.
contract.lifetime: One adapter shares a 90-second verification deadline across pre-placement and pre-commit observations; an unsettled owned process gets a separate 5-second exit-confirmation budget. Large ID3 originals keep the previous slower complete-read behavior under the same caller/deadline checks; native speed is not promised for that signature.
contract.cleanup: Cancel only the exact owned native job, observe terminal exit, and preserve work on unknown start/exit. Never clean another job or original file.
contract.outcomes: A validated prefix selects complete byte hashing for ID3 originals before dispatch. Other native success requires cursor-drained SHA output and unchanged stat. Native errors, malformed output, cancellation or changed sources never trigger a legacy retry; complete-byte source identity remains mandatory.
contract.retry: No native start replay, content cache reuse or uncertain save replay. Pre-placement and pre-commit each make a new full-content observation.
contract.distribution: The two operation-builders serialize this canonical function into their scripts/assemble.js; no installed cross-plugin import or shared AI runtime update is involved. Only Mini and Archive opt into native reads. Five other photo templates receive the synchronized local-client copy without opting in.

Mini and Archive assembly-intent tests use a virtual 4 GiB stat and forbid whole-file range transfers while retaining commit/source-change checks. Ownership coverage and these fixtures do not promote semantic review, whole-template acceptance, Windows, playback or export. embeddedPrograms.description: Serializes canonical legacy file observation, nativeSourceFiles and input/authoring helpers with the template assembly policy into the self-contained installed assembly program. The native adapter and all its job-status/cancellation callbacks retain native-source-files ownership; assembly policy composes the two confirmation boundaries.
embeddedPrograms.input: Canonical helper function bytes plus local assembly policy and assemble.template.js; no runtime import or implicit host global.
embeddedPrograms.output: plugins/archive-vlog/scripts/assemble.js with SDK-safe raw-file native verification before placement and before commit.
embeddedPrograms.lifetime: Build/check invocation owns serialization; installed nativeSourceFiles owns only its exact process and shared verification deadline. Assembly saved-state/receipt ownership stays with template-run.

findings.title: Shipped photo inventory omitted path required by hidden source binding.
findings.mechanism: Actual shipped inventory plus two videos and one photo reached invalid source binding before search. Previous music fixtures projected videos only and missed this path.
findings.acceptance: Carry the exact native photo path through reobserved inventory, current Project binding, full-content admission and original saved continuation.
findings.resolution: Photo inventory now includes its exact observed path (null when unavailable). Existing input and durable owners remain unchanged. Actual-script mixed-entry and restoration regression cover the seam.
findings.validationLimits: Actual panel entry + shipped inventory + canonical input owner in isolated fixtures; assembly verifier is an explicit readback boundary. No actual saved mixed Draft, installed UI, playback/export or Windows verdict.

findings.title: Preparation still promised one video while both entry policies require two.
findings.mechanism: prepare[0] said at least one video despite hint/runtime requiring two distinct videos.
findings.acceptance: Preparation, hint and both runtime entries preserve the chosen two-video/optional-photo design.
findings.resolution: Preparation now requires at least two different video clips, optional photos, max50 total; source-contract RED/GREEN captures the old mismatch.
findings.validationLimits: Wording/source admission checks; no installed gallery rendering, playback or export verdict.

findings.title: Current file observations do not attest the original bytes of the past server scene index.
findings.mechanism: Search sends the Resource/index owner; current in-run full hashes only bind current bytes. Actual app sampled analysis fingerprint is best-effort; normal relink intentionally preserves analysis.
findings.acceptance: Establish existing backend index-generation identity/reuse policy and same-content relink behavior before designing any new SDK or invalidation; reproduce actual stale hits separately.

findings.title: Original-file preview owns readiness, cancellation and teardown without a whole-track browser Blob.
findings.mechanism: The former full-file read/Blob and metadata-only promise could outlive Stop and admit same-render duplicate Audio. Existing asset ownership now controls local URL preparation, one cancelable browser Audio, deadline/progress and observed cleanup.
findings.acceptance: Reproduce pending metadata/cancel/large track and reuse bounded existing owner without altering seek/fade design.
findings.resolution: Original-file streaming preserves section/fade design and source admission; Stop settles waits, same-tick ref admission prevents overlap, and cleanup uncertainty is retained before any replacement.
findings.validationLimits: Actual-callback fixtures and final-source native Audio under production sandbox/CSP with fixture React refs/UI setters and generated WAV. No installed full PanelHost UI, native Windows, strict browser buffering bound or real Draft playback/export verdict.

findings.title: Malformed supplied metrics remain separate from the repaired font readiness lifetime.
findings.mechanism: Present-but-invalid metrics can bypass absent-metrics fallback. Normal Adjust does not edit metrics; occurrence within supported persisted input is still unproven.
findings.acceptance: First establish a supported input path for malformed metrics; then preserve declared fallback/design policy and avoid invalid SVG geometry.

findings.title: Title scrim and near-equal look values can share SVG IDs across instances.
findings.mechanism: Title uses fixed av-title-scrim; look id rounds parameter values while filter computations use original values.
findings.acceptance: Reproduce simultaneous distinct settings in one render document before changing instance-ID policy.

findings.title: Motion/fade raw parameters rely partly on caller finiteness.
findings.mechanism: holdSeconds/cover and duration Infinity are not comprehensively rejected in render functions; normal builder inputs may already constrain them.
findings.acceptance: Verify normal and Adjust caller admission, then reproduce invalid render parameters without changing valid-input appearance.

findings.title: Legacy root wrapper only probes the default skill folder.
findings.mechanism: hostRoots derives ~/.selects/skills/id and mutable hostSdk wrapper; actual alternate configured installation and concurrent realm need verification.
findings.acceptance: Reuse canonical client/bootstrap and discover configured roots while preserving installed bytes and current default-root consumers.

findings.title: Changed glyphs, stale request return and font failures now settle the owned render lifetime.
findings.mechanism: Initial-only font readiness skipped changed glyphs; key-only results could accept retired A on A->B->A; synchronous host throws could leave earlier rejection unobserved; overdue success could outrun its timer. Native hosts ignored authored handles/cancellation.
findings.acceptance: Current committed request only; bounded success/error/cleanup; pending native graphic cannot be captured as ready; cancelled document cannot silently succeed; fresh document recovers without changing normal designs.
findings.resolution: One canonical render-fonts owner in both standalone Archive programs; matching result identity and commit-time release; observed async failure and monotonic deadline. Existing native frame paths use the companion bounded Remotion readiness owner.
findings.validationLimits: Actual standalone Electron renderer/Player/preload cases and source fixtures; not installed full app, composed video/audio playback, encoded video export, Windows, malformed metrics or all-template acceptance.

findings.title: Color grades preserve original alpha and source lifetime across strength zero.
findings.mechanism: Arithmetic additions multiplied premultiplied alpha/RGB; the zero-strength branch moved Source to a different React tree position.
findings.acceptance: All source coverage retained, independent RGB grade, normal opaque samples unchanged, zero toggles retain the original and real owner unmount/replacement cleans once.
findings.remaining: Installed full-app, saved Draft, whole-video/audio playback, encoded export and Windows acceptance remain open.
findings.resolution: The common useColorFilter keeps fixed source slots, opaque RGB input, final original-alpha coverage, and unique stable per-mount identities. The three template designs retain their original math.
findings.validationLimits: Unit/standard-model and isolated Chromium evidence only; installed app, whole-video/audio playback, encoded export, Windows and overall template acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Shared file helpers have one source without conflating distinct media policies.
findings.mechanism: A whole copied av-host equality check coupled another app to Archive media adapters despite different dependencies and execution policies.
findings.acceptance: Canonical shared helpers match across declared consumers; adapters retain behavior and complete emitted runtime stays unchanged.
findings.resolution: Extract common facade only, keep media owners, enforce strict canonical boundary checks and real adapter tests.
findings.validationLimits: Source/unit adapter compatibility; installed app, save/playback/export and Windows acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Missing translation keys inherited JavaScript prototype entries and returned empty labels.
findings.mechanism: constructor, toString and __proto__ are absent from STRINGS but ordinary indexed lookup still reads their inherited values. t returns an empty message and tOr bypasses its supplied fallback. Missing interpolation variables could also read inherited constructor/toString values instead of preserving placeholders.
findings.acceptance: Only registered own dictionary messages resolve; missing keys preserve the key or caller fallback, while explicit own messages, existing translation forms and template isolation retain behavior.
findings.resolution: One canonical runtime checks own dictionary entries for both locale/English lookup and optional-key admission. All seven original implementations reproduce the failure.
findings.validationLimits: Actual-source translation calls and compiled runtime/legacy checks; no claimed installed UI symptom, full playback/export or Windows acceptance.
